ggplot2.name: ggplot2
ggplot2.role: Implements Leland Wilkinson's 'Grammar of Graphics'. Composes charts in independent layers: data + aesthetic mappings (aes) + geometric shapes (geom_*) + scales.

dplyr.name: dplyr
dplyr.role: Provides a consistent grammar of data transformation. Core verbs: filter (rows), select (columns), mutate (new columns), summarise (aggregations), and arrange (sorting).

tidyr.name: tidyr
tidyr.role: Helps format data so each variable is a column and each observation is a row using pivot_longer() and pivot_wider().

shiny.name: shiny
shiny.role: Turns R code into interactive dashboards. Separates UI layout from reactive server logic via an event-driven reactive dependency graph.

readr.name: readr
readr.role: Reads rectangular data (CSV, TSV, fixed-width) fast, with automatic column type parsing and reproducible parsing issues reporting.

purrr.name: purrr
purrr.role: Replaces for-loops with type-safe iteration tools (map, map_dfr, walk) promoting pure, vector-oriented programming.

tibble.name: tibble
tibble.role: A modern reimagining of R data frames. Never changes variable names or types silently, and prints previews cleanly.

stringr.name: stringr
stringr.role: Provides consistent string operations prefixed with 'str_' based on the ICU library.

forcats.name: forcats
forcats.role: Tools for categorical variables: reordering levels (fct_reorder), lumping rare levels (fct_lump), and recoding.

jsonlite.name: jsonlite
jsonlite.role: Fast, robust JSON parser and generator for bidirectional R-to-JSON data interchange.

data.table.name: data.table
data.table.role: High-performance alternative to data frames using concise DT[i, j, by] syntax for filtering rows (i), calculating columns (j), and grouping (by). Highly optimized for large datasets with in-place modifications (:=) and fast file reading with fread().

lubridate.name: lubridate
lubridate.role: Simplifies working with date and time data in R. Provides intuitive functions to parse character strings (ymd, mdy), extract components (year, month), and perform arithmetic using durations and periods.

httr2.name: httr2
httr2.role: Modern HTTP client for interacting with web APIs and network resources. Uses piped workflows to construct requests (request), configure authentication and headers, and parse structured responses (resp_body_json).

rvest.name: rvest
rvest.role: Makes web scraping simple by reading and extracting data from HTML web pages. Uses CSS selectors or XPath expressions via read_html(), html_elements(), and html_text2() to turn web pages into tidy data.

testthat.name: testthat
testthat.role: R's standard unit testing framework for verifying that code works as expected. Organizes test assertions into test_that() blocks using clear expectations such as expect_equal(), expect_true(), and expect_error().

lme4.name: lme4
lme4.role: Fits linear (lmer) and generalized linear (glmer) mixed-effects models that include both fixed and random effects. Designed for analyzing hierarchical, clustered, or repeated-measures experimental data.

survival.name: survival
survival.role: The core R package for time-to-event and survival data analysis. Builds survival objects using Surv(), computes Kaplan-Meier survival curves with survfit(), and fits Cox proportional hazards models using coxph().

caret.name: caret
caret.role: Provides a unified interface for building, training, and evaluating predictive machine learning models. Simplifies workflows for data splitting, feature pre-processing, and hyperparameter tuning with the train() function.

rmarkdown.name: rmarkdown
rmarkdown.role: Authoring framework for data science that combines narrative text with executable R code chunks. Uses knitr and Pandoc to compile reproducible documents into HTML, PDF, or Microsoft Word formats.

devtools.name: devtools
devtools.role: A suite of developer tools that streamlines the process of building and maintaining R packages. Automates common development tasks including code reloading (load_all), documentation generation (document), and running test suites (test).
